title: How to join the BluEmpress closed test

requirements.device: An Android phone or tablet signed in to Google Play
requirements.account: A Google account (the email you enter must be the one you use on Google Play)
requirements.commitment: Keep the app installed and stay opted in for 14 days in a row

steps.title: Sign up
steps.detail: Enter your email at the signup form. You are added to the tester list automatically.

steps.title: Opt in
steps.detail: Open the opt-in page signed in with the same Google account and tap Become a tester.

steps.title: Install and keep it
steps.detail: Install BluEmpress from Google Play. Keep it installed and stay opted in for 14 days. Open it now and then.

feedbackWanted: Anything that crashes, freezes, or looks broken
Replies that feel wrong, off-tone, or unsafe
Moods, portraits, and BluRoom Check: do they feel right?
Voice: does speaking and read-aloud work on your phone?
Memory and Studio desk: confusing or useful?
Your phone model and Android version when reporting a bug
notes: Testing is voluntary. No payment, reward, or compensation is promised.
Never share passwords or private information in a report.
